tone.target: bright crunchy power-pop rhythm with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: bright crunchy power-pop rhythm with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing an OD pedal for bite, followed by a UK 45/Plexi style amp model, paired with a vintage cabinet to deliver the required crunchy power-pop rhythm tone.
corrections: favor bright crunch over mid-gain fuzz
